findings.title: The new per-phase pass/fail screenshot check cannot pass: crew level 2 phase 1 is identical to an undamaged crew room by design
findings.claim: The default-zoom check requires that in each blink phase, every damaged room on both ships can be told apart from an undamaged one. The restored level-2 row gives crew level 2 phase 1 a solid `hot` fill with a `glass` stroke and no hatch. Crew level 0 is no fill over the `hot` outline with a `glass` stroke and no hatch. Those two look exactly the same. So the phase-1 crew shot fails the check every time. This is the CRT rule: the blink itself is the signal. The check's wording contradicts the table.
findings.evidence: spec L132 ('every damaged room on both ships must be told apart from an undamaged one ... in both blink phases (take one shot per phase)'); spec L103 (crew 0: none / `glass` / none) and L106 (crew 2 phase 1: `hot` solid / `glass` / none), drawn over the L95 `hot`-filled outline. CRT spec L41 (level 2 alternates a `glass` cut-out and `hot`). tacticalLayer.ts:L125 draws the same hot fill + glass stroke for level 0 and for level 2 off-phase.
findings.why: The check is the explicit acceptance gate for R1-F3. As written, the implementer either fails it or 'fixes' the look by changing crew level 2 phase 1, which would break the CRT rule that was just restored.
findings.fix: Reword L132 as follows. Level 1 must differ from level 0 in each phase. Level 2 must differ from level 0 in at least one phase, and from level 1 in each phase. Crew level 2 phase 1 is expected to match the hull (the blink is the signal).

prior.note: The level-1 tone fill makes level 1 visible regardless of how many hatch lines a room gets: crew `mid` 0xc47a12 inside `hot` 0xffd36b, and enemy `dim` 0x7a4a10 on `glass` 0x0c0e0b (crtTheme.ts:L6). The default-zoom shot is now an explicit gate (L132). The responder's reason for not adopting the hatch-count rule is stated at L117. This resolution depends on R2-F1, which is still open, and on fixing the new L132 wording finding.

Level 2 now matches the CRT spec exactly: L105-L106 and L109-L110 match CRT L41-L42 and tacticalLayer.ts:L124-L133. The level-1 tone fill is still a departure from the listed fixed decision 'The CRT map's colour roles, blinks and hatch rules stay as they are'. It is now labelled as a deviation (L117), but it still has no owner sign-off and no amendment to CRT spec L41-L42, so the two specs now disagree. 'The owner's look gate judges it' (L117) is not reflected in the gate question at L136, which does not ask about the level-1 fill, and no fallback is named. Smallest fix: (1) add the level-1 tone fill explicitly to the owner gate question at L136; (2) state the fallback if the owner rejects it: drop the two level-1 fill cells (L104, L108 → none), giving the pure CRT rule; (3) if approved, add a note amending CRT spec L41-L42.
L86 now lists tests/tacticalModel.test.ts L6 (the import) and L170.
